selected_common_device_context.text: The folder represents the default preset for a device; this can be either the original factory settings or a custom default you have saved. The presets within the folder have custom settings. Presets are included as part of the Core Library and Packs. You can also create and save your own presets.
selected_common_device_context.raw_html: The folder represents the default preset for a device; this can be either the original factory settings or a custom default you have saved. The presets within the folder have custom settings. Presets are included as part of the Core Library and Packs. You can also create and save your own presets.

selected_common_device_context.text: Each Live device loads with its factory settings when added to a track. You can save a device with a set of specified parameter values as a default preset so that the device loads with those settings instead.
selected_common_device_context.raw_html: Each Live device loads with its factory settings when added to a track. You can save a device with a set of specified parameter values as a default preset so that the device loads with those settings instead.

selected_common_device_context.text: To do so, set the desired parameter values for a device, then select the Save as Default Preset option from the device title bar’s Options menu or context menu. This option is available for all of Live’s instruments, MIDI effects, audio effects, and Rack types.
selected_common_device_context.raw_html: To do so, set the desired parameter values for a device, then select the Save as Default Preset option from the device title bar’s Options menu or context menu. This option is available for all of Live’s instruments, MIDI effects, audio effects, and Rack types.

selected_common_device_context.text: You can specify which instrument is added when dropping a sample either into the Device View for an empty MIDI track or onto a Drum Rack pad.
selected_common_device_context.raw_html: You can specify which instrument is added when dropping a sample either into the Device View for an empty MIDI track or onto a Drum Rack pad.

selected_common_device_context.text: To do so, add an empty Sampler or Simpler device to a MIDI track and adjust its settings as needed. Then, drag the device into one of the two Dropping Samples folders: On Device View or On Drum Rack.
selected_common_device_context.raw_html: To do so, add an empty Sampler or Simpler device to a MIDI track and adjust its settings as needed. Then, drag the device into one of the two Dropping Samples folders: On Device View or On Drum Rack.

selected_common_device_context.text: You can also save a default for Drum Rack pads via the Save as Default Pad option from a pad’s context menu, which adds the preset to the On Drum Rack folder as well.
